title: Rooftop While: Guard Break
summary: Navigate rooftop and tree spaces with sprint and crash, survive warden-led pressure, and turn each run into unify progress.
instructions: WASD or Arrow keys move between patrol lanes., Shift opens a short crash window that can stun a patrol., Space emits an ember pulse that drops alert and disables nearby patrol cones.

hud.objective: Use sprint and crash to survive warden patrols, secure three uplinks, and hold extraction long enough to disappear.

overlay.startCopy:

Scout routes through rooftop spaces and identify guard pressure points.

Use while and ember interactions to survive, reposition, and secure rooftop uplinks.

Convert each run into evolve gains that unlock stronger options and open the next challenge band.
